blocks.h2: Choosing a New Heater for an Elmhurst Home
blocks.body: In a mid-century Elmhurst home, a standard gas tank vented through the chimney is the simplest replacement. If the furnace now vents through a side wall, the chimney may be too big for the water heater alone, and a liner or power-vent heater solves that. In newer homes, a larger tank or a tankless heater can keep up with several bathrooms. We'll lay out the options and prices before you decide.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Installation Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: How long does water heater installation take?
items.answer: A standard replacement usually takes a few hours.

items.q: What size water heater do I need?
items.answer: Most homes use a 40 to 50 gallon tank. Larger families may need more. We'll size it to how you use water.

items.q: Do I need a new vent or chimney liner?
items.answer: Sometimes, especially when the water heater is the only appliance left on the chimney. We test and explain.

items.q: Can you install it today if my old one failed?
items.preview: Often, if the size is in stock.
items.answer: Often. Common sizes are usually available the same day.
Often, especially if your home has a pressure regulator or check valve.
